name: charge-and-payment-intent-succeeded
summary: payment_intent.succeeded then charge.succeeded for one payment — different event IDs, same money.
catches: Deduplicating on event ID isn't enough; both events fulfill the same order twice.
diagnosis: Endpoint responses did not meet the scenario's accepted/rejected contract.
manual_check_required: Check your database: one fulfillment/payment record for pi_7a8b9c = correct. Two = the bug.
pass_detail: Endpoint accepted at most one of the two events for the same payment.
